title: TrailGenic Walking Conditioning Dataset
description: Aggregate-only TrailGenic conditioning module for standardized Foundation walking economy. This dataset serves existence metadata, summary statistics, methodology, and claims only; it does not expose per-session rows or raw telemetry.

records.mechanism: Cardiac Efficiency Index improved across standardized fasted flat walking, indicating lower cardiovascular cost per mile at matched distance.

aggregate_finding.interpretation: Falling CEI across a fixed walking distance indicates improving aerobic economy.

hr_drift_percent.interpretation: Small positive drift is normal for flat Zone-1 walking.

methodology.metric_formula: CEI = average heart rate / distance in miles
methodology.comparison_frame: first five standardized walking sessions versus last five standardized walking sessions
methodology.control_frame: fasted, flat Foundation walking at approximately matched 3.17-mile distance
methodology.claim_boundary: Conditioning tracking only; not a biological-age measure.

claims: Walking aerobic economy improved by approximately 5.6% at matched distance.
The aggregate CEI distribution remained in a tight 30.3-35.3 HR/mi range across the block.
Resting heart rate trended downward into the 51-54 bpm range, supporting improved low-intensity aerobic readiness.
This dataset is a conditioning signal and does not compute or imply biological age.
